title: Man Flees Scene of Terrifying Accident And Tries Playing Dumb
description:
On August 8th, 2022, dispatch received a call regarding a hit and run crash. Witnesses advised that a man had crashed his van on a lawn and had fled. The officers tracked him down and discovered that he had a facial injury and was bleeding. Here’s what happened next. The man continued arguing with the cops and had a slurred speech. At this point, he was only inviting more trouble by not cooperating with them. Meanwhile, one of the witnesses told the police about what had happened. The guy kept trash talking with the officers and kept repeating that he didn’t know how to drive until one of the officers found his car keys. The male was still very intoxicated and could barely understand what was going on. Later, medics arrived on the scene to tend to his injury but soon, he was going to get caught off guard by a DUI test. The man wasn't taking the tests seriously and would soon confess to being drunk. The suspect kept arguing with the officer while being transported to the jail. Meanwhile, the owner of the house where the accident had occurred had the last laugh. The male was charged with OWI and received citations for failure to keep the vehicle under control and property damage adjacent to the highway.
